name: Golden Analytics
tagline: AI-native business intelligence and data visualization platform.
description: Golden Analytics is a web-based business intelligence platform that combines data connection, discovery, preparation, analysis, and dashboarding in one tool. It profiles datasets automatically, surfaces patterns, and a 'Slider of Autonomy' lets users dial how much the AI does versus how much they drive themselves — taking a raw dataset to a shared dashboard in as little as two clicks. It offers a free tier, with Team and Enterprise plans that include all features without token metering.
insight: Founded by Francois Ajenstat, Tableau's longtime chief product officer; launched April 2026 with a $7M seed co-led by NEA and Madrona.
edge: Built AI-first rather than bolting AI onto legacy BI, with a 'Slider of Autonomy' that dials how much the AI does versus the analyst.
pros: AI at the core, not bolted on
